communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Connecticut Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Copy of the separation agreement between the Thomaston Board of Education and Superintendent of Schools Francine Coss, as approved by the Board during its November 24, 2026 special meeting.

This request includes all exhibits, attachments and addenda incorporated into the agreement.

If the agreement has been fully executed at the time this request is received or fulfilled, please provide the fully executed version. Otherwise, please provide the version approved by the Board, regardless of its execution status. If the agreement has not been fully executed at the time this request is fulfilled, I would also appreciate receiving a copy upon its execution.

If any portion of the requested records is withheld or redacted, please identify the specific statutory exemption relied upon and provide all reasonably segregable, nonexempt portions.

I also request that, if possible and pursuant to Conn. Gen. Stat. § 1-212(d), fees be waived as I believe this request is in the public interest and not made for commercial gain. The requested documents will be made available to the public at MuckRock.com.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 4 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Sam Bellford
